BUG 1: Freepik Magnific upscale/skin-enhancer response format
  WRONG: result.data.generated[0].url
  CORRECT: result.data.generated[0]  (it's already a string URL)

BUG 2: Upscaling produces a 109MB file. Sending that as base64 to Gemini edit endpoint → request too large → 503 overloaded
  FIX: Run all Gemini edits (grid, close-ups, expressions) on the ORIGINAL base image first, then upscale last
  Pipeline order: generate → edit (on original) → upscale → skin-enhance

BUG 3: Skin enhancer poll URL — do NOT include /faithful/ in path
  WRONG: /v1/ai/skin-enhancer/faithful/{task_id}
  CORRECT: /v1/ai/skin-enhancer/{task_id}
